package.description: Per-app audio routing for multi-monitor Windows 11 — apps play through the speaker paired with the monitor they're on.

en-US.description: Per-app audio routing for multi-monitor Windows 11 — apps play through the speaker paired with the monitor they're on.
en-US.longDescription: ScreenSound automatically routes each app's audio to the speaker paired with the monitor it's displayed on. Move a window from your laptop screen to your TV — the audio follows. Pin specific apps to specific outputs, run silently in the system tray, and forget about manually switching default devices.
en-US.name: ScreenSound
